# Validation checklist (generated by scripts/50_validation.py)

## 1. One event hand-checked

Event 11352: store 6179, product 1111009507 (PL TWIST PRETZELS), week_index 12, promo type display_only.

Treated store rows (also in outputs/handcheck_event.csv):

|   week_index |   units | is_promo   | promo_type   |   price |   base_price |   pred_units |
|-------------:|--------:|:-----------|:-------------|--------:|-------------:|-------------:|
|            4 |      37 | False      | none         |    1.38 |         1.38 |        31.60 |
|            5 |      28 | False      | none         |    1.48 |         1.48 |        29.00 |
|            6 |      29 | False      | none         |    1.49 |         1.49 |        28.51 |
|            7 |      38 | False      | none         |    1.49 |         1.49 |        28.72 |
|            8 |      36 | False      | none         |    1.49 |         1.49 |        28.62 |
|            9 |      31 | False      | none         |    1.46 |         1.46 |        32.39 |
|           10 |      33 | False      | none         |    1.49 |         1.49 |        34.73 |
|           11 |      33 | False      | none         |    1.50 |         1.50 |        31.15 |
|           12 |      39 | True       | display_only |    1.49 |         1.50 |        30.28 |
|           13 |      37 | False      | none         |    1.49 |         1.49 |        33.04 |
|           14 |      26 | False      | none         |    1.48 |         1.48 |        32.44 |
|           15 |      24 | False      | none         |    1.45 |         1.45 |        31.31 |
|           16 |      18 | False      | none         |    1.49 |         1.49 |        32.39 |

- Method A by hand: actual 39 - predicted 30.28 = **8.72** incremental units. Stored value: 8.72.
- Method B by hand: treated change = 39 - 33.12 = 5.88; mean control change over 52 stores = 1.54; DiD = **4.34**. Stored value: 4.34 with 52 controls.
- Post-window by hand: sum(actual - predicted) over weeks 13..16 = **-24.18**. Stored: -24.18.
- Signs and magnitudes MATCH.

## 2. Deliberately broken: fake promotions

- 20,000 random clean non-promo weeks labelled as 'promoted': measured lift **-0.1%** (95% CI -0.6% to +0.3%). Should be ~0 and it is.
- Non-promo weeks 1-4 after a promotion labelled as 'promoted': measured lift **+2.9%** (95% CI +2.7% to +3.2%). This is the post-promotion residual: slightly positive, i.e. no pantry-loading dip at the store-week level.

## 3. Deliberately broken: stores with very different baselines

| group                       |   events |   mean_baseline_units_per_week |   lift_pct |    lo |    hi |   mean_incr_units |
|:----------------------------|---------:|-------------------------------:|-----------:|------:|------:|------------------:|
| bottom 10% stores by volume |     4818 |                          8.285 |      1.053 | 0.985 | 1.129 |            24.682 |
| top 10% stores by volume    |     5344 |                         26.749 |      0.958 | 0.909 | 1.010 |            80.467 |
- Absolute incremental units scale with store size, as they should; lift in % is the comparable quantity across stores. If the two lift% figures differed wildly it would mean the store feature was not doing its job.

## 4. Deeper discounts lift more?

| depth   |   events |   lift_pct |    lo |    hi |
|:--------|---------:|-----------:|------:|------:|
| <=5%    |     5803 |      0.460 | 0.417 | 0.513 |
| 5-15%   |    11388 |      0.607 | 0.587 | 0.628 |
| 15-25%  |    17471 |      0.934 | 0.906 | 0.957 |
| 25-35%  |     9927 |      2.141 | 2.067 | 2.212 |
| >35%    |     4795 |      3.328 | 3.171 | 3.506 |
- Monotone increasing from 5% upward: **True**. (The <=5% bin is feature/display without a price cut, a different lever.)

## 5. Checklist

- [x] Baseline beats the naive week-of-year median on held-out non-promo weeks (RMSE 5.27 vs 8.93; outputs/phase1_results.md)
- [x] Parallel-trends plot produced; treated and control track within 1.3% over t-8..t-1
- [x] Placebo DiD at t-3 is -0.01 units/week (CI -0.08 to 0.06) against a real effect of 7.8
- [x] Deep-discount promotions lift more than shallow ones
- [x] Price elasticity negative for 55/55 products, median -1.78, 40/55 in -1..-4 (outputs/phase3_results.md)
- [x] Bootstrap resamples at event level (src/bootstrap.py), never store-week
- [x] Post-weeks with their own promotion excluded; window truncated at the next promotion (src/metrics.py)
- [x] One event hand-checked above and in outputs/handcheck_event.csv
- [x] Project deliberately broken twice above (fake promotions, extreme stores)
- [x] Every estimate in the app and the note carries a CI
- [x] Limitations written in docs/methodology.md, unhedged
